summary: Iteration 13 (Phase 3a — API key management v2 with test/live envs + hashed secrets, HMAC-signed outbound webhooks with retry, delivery history, API request log middleware) validated end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iter13_api_keys_webhooks.py — one-time reveal on first GET /api-keys (test_secret starts with sk_test_, webhook_secret with whsec_), _reveal cleared on 2nd fetch, POST /api-keys/regenerate returns new plaintext sk_test_ (with body) and sk_test_ (without body — Body(default_factory=dict) defaults env='test', no 422), env='live' returns sk_live_/pk_live_, after regen /api-keys returns only masked hint (10 chars + '…' + 4), PATCH /api-keys/webhook persists URL and returns webhook.events (6 events pre-seeded), POST /webhook/regenerate-secret returns new whsec_ plaintext once. Merchant v1 API: 401 on missing/invalid Authorization, 400 on amount=0.5 (min 1 USDT), 200 on POST /v1/payments with valid sk_test_ returns {id,payment_url,deposit_address,amount_to_send,expires_at~10min,status='initiated'} + merchant_payments doc inserted, GET /v1/payments/{id} echoes full doc, GET /v1/payments returns {data,count} and ?status=paid returns count=0. Webhook delivery: 4s sleep then GET /api-keys/webhook/deliveries returned 1 delivery with event_type='payment.created', status='delivered' status_code=200, and httpbin echoed our X-BizTransPay-Signature/Timestamp/Event-Id/Event-Type headers (verified via response_body inspection). API logs: /v1/* calls recorded with method/path/status/duration_ms/timestamp/user_id. Regression: /auth/me, /notifications, /exchange/rate all 200. Frontend: Playwright on live preview — fresh merchant created via API + token injected → /dashboard/api → OneTimeSecretModal appears with sk_test_ value, close disabled until onetime-ack checked; 4 tabs (tab-keys/tab-webhook/tab-deliveries/tab-logs) all present; env-test/env-live switcher works, btn-generate-live shows on live before generation, clicking triggers confirm() + modal with sk_live_ value; btn-regen-test opens confirm+modal with new sk_test_; webhook-url input + btn-save-webhook persists https://httpbin.org/post, 4 payment.* event badges rendered, deliveries + logs tabs render. Cleanup: pytest merchants + UI merchant deleted via /admin/users/{id}.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py comment in _deliver_webhook is candid — HMAC is signed with secret_HASH not the plaintext webhook secret. Node.js sample in ApiKeys.js correctly uses YOUR_WEBHOOK_SECRET_HASH — good, but a naive merchant will paste their copied plaintext secret and signatures won't match. Recommend Phase 3b either (a) encrypt-at-rest the plaintext webhook secret and sign with it, or (b) return the hash alongside the plaintext in the one-time reveal so merchants can store either.

asyncio.create_task(_attempt()) in _deliver_webhook: if the caller's event loop finishes (e.g. serverless-style), the task is GC'd. In this long-running uvicorn worker it's fine, but the review request note claiming 'fire-and-forget' matches implementation. Note the retry backoff is 30s then 60s — a failed webhook could linger 90s in 'failed'/'pending' state — that's a UX consideration for the deliveries table (pending vs failed vs retrying).

api_log_middleware inserts on EVERY /api/v1/* request even when user_id can't be resolved (401 with unknown key). Those rows have user_id=None and are invisible to the merchant's GET /api-keys/logs (filters by user_id). Consider surfacing 'unauthorized-key' attempts somewhere (admin panel?) — otherwise a merchant will never know someone probed their endpoints with bad keys.

Legacy migration path in _ensure_api_keys keeps legacy `public_key`/`secret_key` fields if present. After migration those legacy fields remain in the doc alongside the new `keys` object — clean them up in a follow-up migration to reduce confusion.
server.py is now 2695 lines (still growing — was 2330 last iter). Split routers overdue.

MerchantPaymentRequest.amount is `float` — susceptible to float-precision (e.g. 0.1+0.2). USDT amounts should be Decimal or int (satoshi-like). Not a blocker for phase 3a since gateway formats with f'{amount:.6f}'.
OneTimeSecretModal in ApiKeys.js uses `alert()`-style confirm() for regen — non-blocking UX; consider a custom shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with the rest of the app.
Frontend DeliveriesTab / LogsTab polling is one-shot on mount — no auto-refresh. Merchants have to switch tabs away and back to see new entries. A 5-10s poll or a manual refresh button would help.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter13 suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter13_api_keys_webhooks.py — MUST be run with `-n 0` (serial) because module-scoped fixtures share plaintext secrets across tests; the repo's pytest.ini defaults to `-n 2 --dist loadscope` which splits classes across workers and breaks this suite. IziPay is 'live' in sandbox (backend/.env has sk_live_… IZIPAY_API_KEY) — creating merchant_payments actually calls izichange.com which is cheap but real. Webhook delivery test relies on httpbin.org/post being up — 4s sleep after POST /v1/payments is enough for the create_task to complete + httpbin round-trip. HMAC is signed with secret_HASH not plaintext (documented compromise) — merchants must hash their copied whsec_ before verifying, and the frontend code sample says 'YOUR_WEBHOOK_SECRET_HASH' — do not change to plaintext until Phase 3b encrypts-at-rest. For UI testing, inject token via localStorage.setItem('btp_token', token) after creating merchant via /api/auth/register (account_type=merchant, phone required, country=SN).
rca of the issue: No functional issues in Phase 3a. The only test-side gotcha was pytest-xdist loadscope splitting my test classes across 2 workers, each creating its own merchant via a module-scoped fixture — so plaintext secrets stored on merchant_ctx in class A weren't visible in class B (KeyError). Fix: run with `-n 0`. Documented for next testing agent.
